changed_factors: Replace largest-remainder integer quota rounding with minimum-change floor/ceiling rounding; all reference statistics, exact capacities, hard Hungarian matching, optimizer rules and gates unchanged.
mechanism_rationale: Endpoint posthoc evidence links quota-induced assignment changes to large conditional gradient jumps. Retain the closest previous valid floor/ceiling allocation; force capacity adaptation whenever data-estimated mass crosses an integer boundary. No tuned deadband or frozen quota.

api_changes.migration: New default-off opt-in Recipe mechanism with native checkpointed cell state; historical source evidence remains separate
Default empty retains original optimizer packet/law;opt-in gradient-history packets persist and validate. No evaluator or RNG inputs.
Default cumulative remains; opt-in data-only memory state checkpoints exactly.
Default largest_remainder retains numerical parent law; opt-in minimum_change adds checkpointed previous allocation. Historical state/source identities remain separate.
